meta.name: Constant approximation · arbitrary norm
meta.regime: For every ε > 0, some constant γ_ε approximates search CVP in any norm
meta.rules: For each fixed ε > 0 return a γ_ε-approximate closest vector for any norm and arbitrary rank-n lattice. The constant may depend on ε. Preserve norm representation, oracle precision and polynomial input-size factors. This differs from an exact-CVP guarantee and from constant factors fixed independently of ε.
